title: Wifi QR code to connect to the Orbic
body:
A Rust application that displays WiFi QR codes on the Orbic's screen for you to connect your device to the Orbic's wifi network.   The Orbic is limited to a 128x128 display. So it does require a short SSID and PW.  The app runs continuously in the background and displays a scannable QR code for 30 seconds when the menu button is held down from 1.5-6 seconds.

https://github.com/drinkingc0ffee/OrbicWifiQR
